verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own documentation has sections titled 'General Instructions', 'Two Factor Authentication' and 'Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID', which suggests first-party setup guidance for registering the key with services. The pack only shows these headings, so the depth and step-by-step quality of the guidance is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of actual step-by-step account-registration walkthroughs, a guided setup app or wizard (nitropy is only shown as a CLI), coverage of common consumer accounts like Google, and independent or hands-on corroboration that setup is easy.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts
